title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: Amendment Parameters by Category
content:
A shipper's declaration under Dangerous Goods Acceptance can be amended within limits that differ from one category to the next. This sheet gives, for all six categories, whether an approved acceptance can still be amended, which declared particulars an amendment may touch, the ceiling on signed amendments, the largest permitted swing in declared gross weight, whether the number of containers may go up, and the amendment cut-off counted back from the cargo cut-off.

| Category | Amendable once approved | Particulars an amendment may change | Signed amendments per acceptance, at most | Largest change of declared gross weight (percent of the weight held before the amendment) | Container count may be raised | Amendment cut-off (hours before cargo cut-off) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| AHL DG Limited Quantity | Yes | gross weight; container count | 3 | 10 | Yes | 24 |
| AHL DG Class 9 Standard | Yes | UN number; proper shipping name; packing group; gross weight; container count | 3 | 10 | Yes | 48 |
| AHL DG Flammables and Corrosives | Yes | UN number; proper shipping name; packing group; gross weight; container count | 2 | 10 | Yes | 48 |
| AHL DG Toxics and Oxidizers | Yes | proper shipping name; packing group; gross weight | 2 | 5 | No | 72 |
| AHL DG Compressed Gases | Yes | proper shipping name; gross weight | 2 | 5 | No | 72 |
| AHL DG Special Approval | No | gross weight | 1 | 2 | No | 120 |

## Notes on the columns

- The IMDG class is absent from every list of changeable particulars.
- Gross weight is changeable in every category; it is the only changeable particular under AHL DG Special Approval.
- The weight column is a percentage of the declared weight as it stood immediately prior to the amendment in question.

## Short answers

**Which categories keep the container count fixed?** AHL DG Toxics and Oxidizers, AHL DG Compressed Gases and AHL DG Special Approval.

**Which category closes amendments once it has approved the goods?** AHL DG Special Approval alone.
